digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center live validation harness
propositions: A vendored Dockerfile builds a live Jira 8.17.1 Data Center test harness from the addono base image pinned by digest, not from an unpullable pre-built image.
Personal Access Token bearer authentication works against the real Jira 8.17.1 instance via programmatically minted tokens at POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens and Authorization: Bearer headers.

The harness readiness probe polls REST v2 until answering with a configurable timeout (default 20 minutes) and skips cleanly when the instance is absent, with participation in the external tier's all-skip canary to prevent vacuous passes.
Teardown verification uses direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoints to assert 404s for created issues, never consulting the search index per ADR 0037§3, ensuring index-independent cleanup.

The harness requires native amd64 runners and Jira 8.x only; it builds into ~879MB, starts in ~3-8 minutes on amd64, has a hard runtime dependency on egress to maven.atlassian.com, and must mount a persistent ~/.m2 volume to avoid re-downloading ~900 artifacts on every start.
